Senior front-end/full-stack engineer role (7+ years) at Grove Collaborative, a sustainability-focused household and personal care ecommerce company. The work centers on customer-facing commerce experiences, leading initiatives from vague problem statements through to shipped, measured outcomes, including architecture decisions and integrations with mobile apps, subscription services, search, analytics, and loyalty systems. Core stack is JavaScript and TypeScript with a modern component framework such as React, Vue, or Svelte, plus GraphQL and Shopify-based commerce systems, alongside design-system and UI component library work.
